quest.title: A Familiar Threat
quest.description: Paimon is curious about Neuvillette. Go talk to him.
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x625, Mora x44000, Hero's Wit x5, Mystic Enhancement Ore x10

chapter.title: The Remains of the Past Day

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: Wait, did I hear that right? Monsieur Neuvillette, are you sure you'd like to take over the case yourself?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: That's right.

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: But why? Technically speaking, cases like this are better left to the Gardes...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Neuvillette, Sedene, hey there! What are you two talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME} and Paimon, please help me talk our Chief Justice out of this. He wants to investigate a case on his own!

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: This is completely unprecedented. How can we have the Iudex acting like a private detective?

choices.text: Planning to break into a new industry?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Thank you for your concern, but I currently have no such plans.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Oh... apologies. I took your question in earnest, but it now occurs to me that it was mostly likely in jest.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So what is it exactly? It sure sounds serious if it's something you've got to investigate personally!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: A Melusine named Kiara received a threat letter.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And then...?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: That is all the information I have acquired at this stage.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh?

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: *sigh* I have no idea why you're so hung up over this.

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: I've checked the schedule in advance, and it seems like there aren't any trials today. So if you insist... I have no objections.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Thank you for understanding. I will leave a note explaining my absence on my desk — I would appreciate it if you could take it to Lady Furina.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: She may have no interest in official affairs, but standard procedure dictates that I'm still responsible for reporting to her.

response.speaker: Sedene
response.text: Yes yes! Understood. I'll come back later and deliver the note to her.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Judging from Sedene's reaction, it must be pretty rare for you to investigate stuff personally. What's so special about this case?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I cannot tell you just yet, but it reminded me of certain past events.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: There could be complicated conflicts of interest behind all this, so I must eliminate all risks in advance.

choices.text: Conflicts of interest?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: C'mon, stop being so secretive! We still have no idea what's going on!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: It is not my intention to keep you in the dark, but I need some time to revisit those memories and collect my thoughts.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Long story short... A little more than four hundred years ago, I became the Iudex of Fontaine and initiated a series of institutional reforms.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: There were few people I could trust, but I had two subordinates who were exceptionally trustworthy and capable: Carole, a Melusine, and Vautrin, leader of the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: They must've been amazing people to receive such high praise from you!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Indeed. Unfortunately, I wasn't able to protect them.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The reforms damaged the interests of some, and the more conservative faction took advantage of Carole's identity to instigate political unrest. Ultimately, they wanted me to yield more of my power.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The incident resulted in Carole taking her own life and Vautrin being exiled. From then on, I've been especially careful when dealing with cases related to Melusines.

choices.text: You're concerned that you're the perpetrator's real target?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: All Melusines used to live a secluded life away from human society.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I granted their wishes when some of them, including Carole, asked me to bring them to the Court of Fontaine.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Many common folk believe that I share a special bond with the Melusines, and whatever they do can be traced back to me.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Some of them — especially those who hold a grudge against me — exploit that belief and stir up conflict over Melusines in an attempt to lay the blame on me.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I have nothing against the opinions of others, but the moment a whirlpool of conspiracy forms, it inevitably affects the innocent.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: And it's already happened once, and I want to make sure it does not happen again.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, even so, why do you have to be the one investigating?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: There's the Gardes, the Marechaussee Phantom, and the Special Security and Surveillance Patrol! Aren't they more than enough to figure out what's going on?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Based on prior experience, there's a high chance that those who hold hostility towards me do not belong to the same department.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The political system of Fontaine is relatively complex and involves the interests of multiple different factions.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: However, since I am technically an outsider in Fontaine, a lot of trouble could be avoided if I personally took on the case.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Outsider?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: But aren't you the Chief Justice of Fontaine? Why would you be an outsider?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I understand where you're coming from, but there is not necessarily a connection between my responsibilities and how I perceive myself.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: You know very well about my true identity and have even met others of my kind in other nations...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Hydro Dragon Sovereign...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Even though I was born with a human form, there's a fundamental difference between dragons and humans.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Taking on the role of Chief Justice does not make me a part of this community. In fact, the status I was granted has prevented me from forming deeper bonds with others.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I have lived in Fontaine for a long time, but I do not belong here. That is why I call myself an outsider — a fish out of water.

choices.text: If you put it that way...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We have nothing to do with all those organizations anyway, so how about we come with you on your investigation?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Let's team up and round up all the bad guys lurking in the dark!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: ...That does not sound like a bad idea. I rarely investigate cases on my own, but with professionals like you around, I'm sure it'll go a lot smoother.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, Paimon's starting to get a little embarrassed. Just leave it to us!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I'll write my note of absence right away. Let us depart together once I am done.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Neuvillette writes a note to Furina and sets it on the desk.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Let us go. We should visit Kiara first and try to gain a better understanding of the situation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Um, so Neuvillette feels like he doesn't truly belong here in Fontaine, but is that really true?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Paimon feels like he has a kinda... skewed perspective on a lot of things. Anyway, let's catch up with him first!

choices.text: We're also outsiders to Fontaine.
Seems like they're using Melusines against you...
Care to explain in detail?
I can introduce you to some amazing detectives.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I trust that you'd be able to work that out with how well-connected you are, but I must apologize. I do not plan on relying on anyone else's help for this matter.

talks.objective: Ask Kiara about the threatening letter

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Whew... The weather's amazing today.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Kiara.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Huh, Monsieur Neuvillette! And you are...

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: #Oh, I remember! You're {NICKNAME} and Paimon. I've heard about you.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Aww, she's adorable! Hey there, it's nice to meet you!

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Hehe, thanks for the compliment. Is there anything I can do for you?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I heard from Sedene that you received a threatening letter.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: A threatening letter... Oh, right, I remember now.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: The letter fell through the crack in my door as I was heading out this morning. It said something about catching me, so I thought someone wanted to play hide-and-seek.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: But Sedene told me it was a threatening letter and that I could be in danger. But that's not gonna happen with everyone looking after me, right?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Have you run into any suspicious-looking people recently?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Suspicious-looking people? What counts as suspicious?

choices.text: Someone who follows you from behind?

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Ah!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Did you think of something?

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Nope! I don't remember meeting anyone like that!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Do you still have the letter with you? I want you to show me what it says.

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Oh, ah... Let's see... Found it!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Now then... "Get lost! If you don't leave the Marechaussee Phantom, I will come and catch you in person. Don't say I didn't warn you!"

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Hmm, a simple threat. Neither the handwriting nor the content itself reveals anything about the writer's intentions.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Are they concealing their identity on purpose?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: We can't rule out that possibility.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Since you can't think of anyone suspicious, I'll be heading back to the Palais Mermonia to review some official documents.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Kiara, you should come with us. It's safer if you stay close by.

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Sure!

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Wait, no, no, no, I still have a case to work on! I promised Eloffe that I'd check on her place later.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: But you're being watched right now. Going off on your own could be dangerous...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And that's where we come in to help! We'll stay with Kiara and make sure she's safe.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: With us around, anyone scheming to hurt Kiara can forget about it!

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: #Thank you, {NICKNAME}, Big Sis Paimon!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Big Sis Paimon...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh... Ahem! Don't worry, your Big Sis Paimon is super strong!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Alright, let us go our separate ways for now. Please take care of Kiara.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: We'll take her to Eloffe's place right away. See you around!

choices.text: Someone who always strikes up a conversation with you?

dialogues.speaker: Graciette
dialogues.text: We should've gone up to him and said something...

dialogues.speaker: Trudaine
dialogues.text: Yeah, that was the perfect opportunity...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Strange... Paimon felt like someone was following us...

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Eloffe!

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: Kiara, you're here! Huh? Wait, aren't these two...

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: #They're {NICKNAME} and Big Sis Paimon!

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: I thought so. What brings you here?

choices.text: We're on a secret mission.

response.speaker: Eloffe
response.text: Alright, guess I shouldn't have asked.

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: May I begin inspecting the store as planned?

response.speaker: Eloffe
response.text: Of course, go ahead!

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Hmm... No hazards detected. You've cleared the inspection. Seems like the criminal from that case last month never set foot in here at all.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: That was quick! What were you inspecting?

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: I took a look around the shop. Neuvillette says that us Melusines have special eyes that can see things people can't.

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Things like bloodstains. No matter how hard you try to clean them up, we Melusines can see their residual stains for some time. Pretty cool, huh?

response.speaker: Eloffe
response.text: Alright, alright, now that you're done inspecting, can we have a chat?

response.speaker: Eloffe
response.text: Hear me out. I'm planning to release an outfit for children next month and wanted to hire you as my model. Is that okay with you?

response.speaker: Kiara
response.text: Of course! Is there anything I need to do?

response.speaker: Eloffe
response.text: Please wait a moment while I take your measurements. The sample should be a perfect fit...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Seems like they get along really well!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Huh, {NICKNAME}? What are you looking at?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I think there's someone over there...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Is there really someone watching us!? Shh... Let's sneak over and take a look.

choices.text: We're protecting Kiara.

response.speaker: Eloffe
response.text: Did you run into any trouble?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Eh, it's not really trouble anymore with us around.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Strange... Why isn't he back yet...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Gotcha!

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Whoa!!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Charlotte!? What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, don't tell Paimon you're the one who sent Kiara that threatening letter! But you don't seem like the type to—

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Threat letter? What threat letter?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you doing here, exactly?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Uh, this is starting to feel like an interrogation... Okay, I'll be straight with you. I don't know the slightest thing about that threat letter you mentioned — I only wanted to follow Monsieur Neuvillette and request an interview with him.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: You wanna interview him?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: That's right! I'm not the only one, y'know. Interviewing him is every journalist's dream.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: But it's not an easy task to accomplish. The Palais Mermonia rarely accepts appointment requests from us, and we never have the chance to interrupt when the court's in session.

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: So imagine how surprised I was seeing him out on the streets today! It seemed like you were investigating something too... The perfect opportunity to whip up an exclusive, don't you think?

dialogues.speaker: Charlotte
dialogues.text: Of course, I'll make sure to turn in my manuscript to him for review. I have my principles, and I'd never publish an article without the consent of all parties involved.

choices.text: I don't think he'd agree...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Yeah! We're doing a secret investigation that can't be made public knowledge!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I see... Well, if you say so, I guess I'll put this matter aside for now. What a shame... Chances like this don't come by very often, you know.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: In exchange, could you tell me what the threat letter is about? I swear I won't tell!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Alright then...

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: You tell Charlotte about the letter Kiara received...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: WHAT!? Someone's targeting a cute little Melusine?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Shh, not so loud!

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: It just so happens that I did an interview with Kiara — last month, in fact. It was well-received by our readers, so I was planning to continue the series... and now someone's coming after her?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: I'll ask my colleagues about it. Who knows? We might find something. And don't worry, I know what I'm doing! This secret's safe with me.

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: But I gotta warn you, even if I keep my lips sealed, others will know eventually.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Why?

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: People care a great deal about Monsieur Neuvillette's each and every move. Some may have already realized that something was up. Besides, the case involves Melusines, so...

response.speaker: Charlotte
response.text: Anyway, I'll get going now. Watch yourselves, alright?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Well, that was a nice chat... Let's head back and check on Kiara.

choices.text: It's better if we kept this secret.

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: What do you think? The design looks pretty good, huh?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: I think it's great!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: It's very pretty indeed.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Clorinde! What are you doing here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It seems that you just showed up out of nowhere.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: As I passed by the Palais Mermonia, I heard that Neuvillette was investigating a case with you.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Technically speaking, he and I are under an employer-employee relationship. It didn't feel right to have my employer personally take on such trivial cases.

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: I happen to have some time at the moment and came to take a look. I sometimes have my clothes custom-made at this boutique, in any case, so we always have a lot to talk about.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Neuvillette sure is lucky to have someone like you!

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Leave this to me. You should go meet up with Neuvillette.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Okay then, we'll leave Kiara in your hands. C'mon, Let's go find Neuvillette!

talks.objective: Ask Neuvillette about how the investigation is coming along

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Oh? You're back. Is everything alright?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We ran into Clorinde! She offered to help us protect Kiara.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: That is good to hear — I trust her abilities. It looks like Kiara's in good hands.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We thought so too! Well, did you find any leads?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I've been looking through the case records. Specifically, inspection reports submitted by Kiara and major cases I've judged over the past decade.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I've come up with two plans. On one hand, I could start with Kiara and track down the group behind all this, step by step.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: On the other... I could also analyze the conflicting interests of these major cases and confirm my suspicions if there is indeed a mysterious group that bears a grudge against me.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hmm, they both sound like pretty solid plans! But can you really finish browsing through all these documents? That's a lot of reading... even for Paimon.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Don't worry, I'm a fast reader when it comes to official documents. After all, I have several hundred years of reviewing under my belt.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We'll help you read through them! We have nothing else to do.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Thank you. I will continue looking through the ones piled up on the desk, but feel free to browse through anything else in this room.

dialogues.speaker: About Wriothesley...
dialogues.text: "The defendant, Wriothesley, has confessed to his crimes, and was declared guilty by Iudex Neuvillette."

dialogues.speaker: About Wriothesley...
dialogues.text: "Wriothesley will be exiled to the Fortress of Meropide, where he will be serving his sentence."

dialogues.speaker: About Wriothesley...
dialogues.text: "During the trial, Neuvillette remained silent for a long time."

dialogues.speaker: About the Spina di Rosula...
dialogues.text: "Callas, boss of the Spina di Rosula, was defeated in the duel and died of serious injuries."

dialogues.speaker: About the Spina di Rosula...
dialogues.text: "The defense of his honor has now come to a close. The defendant did not raise any objections throughout the trial."

dialogues.speaker: About the Spina di Rosula...
dialogues.text: "Iudex Neuvillette reserved judgment in this case. Its details are still under investigation."

dialogues.speaker: About the smuggling case...
dialogues.text: "The smuggling case was solved by the joint forces of the Gardes and Marechaussee Phantom."

dialogues.speaker: About the smuggling case...
dialogues.text: "The principal offenders have received judgment based on the severity of their crimes."

dialogues.speaker: About the smuggling case...
dialogues.text: "Please refer to the appendix for the list of names."

dialogues.speaker: About the bribery case...
dialogues.text: "There has been a severe bribery scandal within the Gardes."

dialogues.speaker: About the bribery case...
dialogues.text: "The Special Security and Surveillance Patrol has investigated the case. All suspects involved have been arrested."

dialogues.speaker: About the bribery case...
dialogues.text: "The suspects have confessed to their crimes."

dialogues.speaker: About the Representative Council's proposal...
dialogues.text: "The Representative Council has filed a request to collaborate with the Marechaussee Phantom on certain public events."

dialogues.speaker: About the Representative Council's proposal...
dialogues.text: "Based on research, they believe that Melusines can enhance the popularity of these events."

dialogues.speaker: About the Representative Council's proposal...
dialogues.text: "The Marechaussee Phantom has yet to respond. However, it has not prohibited the Melusines from participating in such activities."

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: ...You're done reading already? Please wait a moment, I still need some time.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Have you made any progress?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: We skimmed through some of them, but there wasn't anything useful.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: There's so many documents lying around! Just how many cases have you handled!?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I would love to answer that question, but the truth is, I've never made a precise calculation myself.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: If memory serves me right, there should be at least one hundred thousand cases. The documents you see are just a small fraction of what is really there.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whoa... that's a lot! Looks like the work of a Chief Justice isn't easy at all.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: That might be how it seems like from another's perspective, but trials and official duties are, to me, simply routine.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: There are many documents here. Take a break if you're tired.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Whew, you read Paimon's mind!

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Alright, let us take a break then.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... Even though resting is a part of taking a break, shouldn't we at least talk about something?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: All this silence is making Paimon feel really awkward...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Please pardon my lack of consideration. People rarely come to the Palais Mermonia for matters outside of work. To be quite honest, I'm not sure what we should do.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Would you like to have some drinks, perhaps? You must be thirsty after all that work.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Ooh, drinks! Thank you!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon wonders what Neuvillette likes to drink... Oh! Maybe he's a fan of really fancy wines!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: He seems like the type of person who'd own an entire winery... Y'know, like Diluc!

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: Neuvillette momentarily leaves and brings back several exquisite wine glasses...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Uh... What's inside these glasses? It looks just like water...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: An astute observation. It is indeed water.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So it's just plain old water!?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: What did you think it was?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Um... Since you're the Chief Justice and all, Paimon thought you'd prefer something more sophisticated.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: This water is indeed very special. It would not be an overstatement to call it "sophisticated."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: I believe you've already tried Fonta. In fact, there are many other drink factories in Fontaine, including those that specialize in packaging pure drinking water.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Said water is sourced from all across Teyvat, including Mondstadt's Cider Lake, Liyue's Qingce Village, and Inazuma's Konda Village...

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Here's one of their latest products: water from Sumeru's Apam Woods.

choices.text: Is there any difference?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: If I were to comment on their mouthfeel... The waters of Cider Lake warm the heart, the waters of Qingce Village have a poignant touch, while one might call the waters of Konda Village placid.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Distinct differences exist between the waters of each area. You'll appreciate their intricacies once you taste them carefully.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Really? Let Paimon try...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: What do you think?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Nope, Paimon couldn't taste any difference at all! Isn't this just normal water?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: How regrettable. It seems like you still have a long way to go in refining your tastes.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hey, this doesn't have to do with refining our tastes! Paimon's pretty sure most ordinary people can't tell the difference... How'd you do it anyway?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh! Could it be because you're the Hydro Dragon?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: That could be the case.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, we are allowed to bring that up, right? Since no one else is around...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, Paimon's been wanting to ask this for ages! If you're the Hydro Dragon, why would you become Chief Justice in human society?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, sorry, Paimon was just curious. You don't have to answer!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: There's nothing to hide. I was simply organizing my thoughts.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I accepted this position because I wanted to seek out answers to questions that have perplexed me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Questions? Are there really things you can't figure out?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Many, in fact. But the one question that puzzles me the most concerns my own existence.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: In essence... I neither know why I was born in this form, nor do I understand where my long life should take me.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I lost many memories from the moment I was born. The Primordial Sea, for example. I can only vaguely recall its connection to me, but I am unaware of what that connection is exactly.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Is there anyone who can answer those questions?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Perhaps the elemental dragons of other nations may have some form of an answer. However, they are scattered across all of Teyvat. Abruptly visiting could very well pose an unpredictable risk.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: True... Some of them have very... unique personalities too.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I have been holding on to these unanswered questions for a long time...

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: But there's one thing I've discovered along the way: My emotions easily resonate with those of others... even I don't have the slightest idea what they mean.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: My guess would be that there are at least some similarities between humans and myself. By observing their behavior, perhaps I could one day understand the meaning of my existence.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I see.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Have you made any progress then?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Perhaps, but I find such progress difficult to describe. As an outsider, chances to engage in meaningful interactions with others are few and far between.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: That's why I'm quite thankful for this chat — such opportunities are rare. Alas, time is limited. We should move on with our investigation.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Are we gonna continue reading these documents? Ugh, Paimon's getting dizzy already.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: I wasn't able to find any leads even after browsing through most of the documents, but while we were on the topic of "water" a moment ago, another idea came to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Water? Do you mean...

response.speaker: Player
response.text: The Fountain of Lucine?

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: That's right.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: The Fountain of Lucine is where all of Fontaine's waters converge. It is the vessel of countless memories and emotions.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: If there really were an organization attempting to use Melusines against me, they should also hold an intense resentment towards me.

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Perhaps we'll be able to find some new leads by sensing the Hydro element within the fountain.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh. Why didn't Paimon think of that? C'mon, let's go take a look!

response.speaker: Neuvillette
response.text: Perhaps we should go, there shouldn't be too many people near the Fountain of Lucine during the evening.

choices.text: They're all just water, aren't they?

dialogues.speaker: Sedene
dialogues.text: I hope the Chief Justice returns soon...

dialogues.speaker: "Neuvillette's Note"
dialogues.text: "Away for personal reasons. Will be back in a day."

dialogues.speaker: Eloffe
dialogues.text: I think light and frilly clothes look best on you. You'd definitely look cute wearing them.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: I love them too! Especially the soft and fluffy kind...

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: How has your work been recently?

dialogues.speaker: Clorinde
dialogues.text: Same as usual. My schedule normally isn't too packed, so I have plenty of time for myself.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Ooh, then shall we go out to play? How about a beach vacation, like last time?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: I've even signed up as a volunteer lifeguard! I'm really good at swimming, so I'm sure I can help.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: It's been a while since we last saw Neuvillette. Paimon wonders what he's been up to.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon has so many questions about his true identity... Let's go talk to him and find out!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Paimon's been thinking... You called yourself a "fish out of water," right?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But since you're the Hydro Dragon, wouldn't "dragon out of water" suit you better?

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Thank you for your suggestion. I will consider using the more accurate term in private occasions.

dialogues.speaker: Neuvillette
dialogues.text: Please allow me to rephrase: As a dragon out of water...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Pfft! That sounds kinda weird! Let's stick with the previous version instead.

dialogues.speaker: Graciette
dialogues.text: I never thought I'd see him here...

dialogues.speaker: Trudaine
dialogues.text: Does anyone have a Kamera?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: So, Kiara, how old are you?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: Hmm, lemme think... One, two, ten... Uh, I can't remember.

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: But I remember coming to the Court of Fontaine with Carole and Neuvillette. That must've been a long time ago.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Carole... Didn't Neuvillette mention her just now? That was more than four hundred years ago! Why would Paimon be a big sister to you?

dialogues.speaker: Kiara
dialogues.text: My memory isn't that good, but Carole told me I could address others based on how I feel about them... Paimon feels a lot more grown-up than me, so you're Big Sis.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh, Paimon sees...
